description: Global risk indicator package. Values below are THIRD-PARTY SNAPSHOTS from https://www.musaeai.com/ (www subdomain; bare domain serves a different CBAM page). Each metric carries BOTH `method` (how this package got it: always third_party_snapshot) AND `underlying_method` (how the page itself says it got it: auto/manual/auto+manual/mixed, preserved verbatim). MOVE is flagged value_is_estimate=true for post-2026-11-02 readings (VXTLT regression estimate, not ICE print). BAMLC0A0CM confirmed via FRED as the IG OAS series (prior v2 mislabel retracted). Page is personal research; thresholds not backtested; not investment advice.
